task: FV2-022 — Flutter Design V2 protected image viewer overlay parity
summary: Implemented a responsive, viewport-filling Flutter protected image viewer aligned to the web overlay. Preserved authenticated image loading and the separate protected save action. No web, API, ACL, storage, conversation, or media behavior changed.

checks.name: Test-first viewer states and responsive geometry
checks.observation: Desktop 1440×900 and compact 390×844 overlay bounds, header/filename, close target, separate download visibility, fit-to-window stage, transient error retry, unavailable state, and malformed image decode retry are covered. New regressions failed before the corresponding implementation changes.

checks.name: Android signed ABI-split Release build
checks.observation: Artifacts are ignored local build outputs and were not added to Git. The arm64 APK signature was verified against the expected release certificate (SHA-256 394e369de2d566b4897493ee498da2f27745e514c49ca88c6489b0b0a811212b); generated Android versionCode is 2043. The universal APK is ~112 MB and was not staged or published.

checks.name: Android emulator runtime visual acceptance
checks.observation: The emulator currently has app version 1.0.29, versionCode 2053. The generated arm64 artifact has versionCode 2043. No install/downgrade was attempted to avoid replacing the newer installed build or risking its app state.

checks.name: macOS runtime visual acceptance
checks.observation: The already-running app exposed no Flutter VM service; attach remained at 'Waiting for a connection from Flutter on macOS'. The app was not restarted, preserving its active session and avoiding another Keychain prompt.

checks.name: Windows runtime visual acceptance
checks.observation: No Windows runtime was available on this host.

checks.name: Spec traceability verifier
checks.observation: PowerShell Core is not installed on this macOS host. The change adds a UI-only backlog leaf; no approved requirement or contract text changed.

limitations: FV2-022 remains open until live Android/macOS/Windows overlay acceptance is completed.
The existing user-owned clients/flutter/packages/flutter_webrtc/.gitignore change was not modified or included in this evidence scope.
No APK, generated media, or build output was committed.
